text:
Keisha Morgan: Heads-up 1010we have a delivery gap for audit logs affecting a subset of private-deploy (VPC) customers in the eu-west region. This may impact compliance reporting and onboarding verification for a handful of accounts, including two renewal-window customers. Engineers traced it to a misconfigured S3 replication rule during last night's retention policy rollout.

Tom Baker: How many tenants? Are logs unrecoverable or delayed? Any PII exposure?

Keisha Morgan: 9 tenants impacted. Logs are delayed, not deleted; we still have the primary objects but cross-region replication stalled and some tombstones were incorrectly filtered. No evidence of access/PII exposure. We can backfill the replication and rehydrate the missing objects from the primary bucket; estimate for full catch-up per-tenant ~2-6 hours depending on size.

Arjun Patel: From CS perspective we need: (1) a short proactive note to affected accounts explaining impact and ETA, (2) a compliance-focused escalation for regulated tenants with templated language for legal/regulatory teams, and (3) a tailored outreach for the two renewal accounts offering an assurance call and a compliance attestation once backfill completes.

Sofia Lopez: Agreed. Tone should be factual and reassuring. Offer assisted verification (we'll run the customer's compliance checks with them) and a commitment to a signed attestation of log integrity post-recovery. For renewals add an offer for extended log retention at no charge for the remainder of the current term.

Jules Martin (Legal): We approve the attestation concept but avoid guaranteeing remedial services that would bind us beyond our contract language. Use: "We will provide a post-incident attestation describing the recovery steps and scope of data restored; any changes to retention or contractual terms will be discussed and documented via your account team." Keep credit/retention offers as "subject to terms and exec approval" in initial outreach.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1142 opened (severity: high for regulated tenants). Recovery runbook created.

Keisha Morgan: Draft customer note below (short form). Please flag edits for compliance/regulatory tenants and renewal cohort.

```
Subject: Notice: temporary delay in audit log delivery for private deployments (eu-west)

Hi [Customer name],

We discovered a delay delivering audit logs for private deployments in the eu-west region that may affect recent activity records and compliance reports. Our engineers identified a misconfiguration in replication rules during a retention rollout and are performing a targeted rehydration to restore the missing objects. We expect full delivery to complete for most affected accounts within 2-6 hours; we'll send an update when your account is fully caught up.

What we're doing:
- Performing a prioritized backfill from the primary log bucket to restore any delayed items.
- Running integrity checks and producing a post-incident attestation detailing the scope of restored logs.
- Offering an assisted verification session to walk through restored records and any reportable gaps.

What you can expect next:
- Your CS lead will reach out with an account-specific ETA and to schedule verification if desired.
- For customers with compliance needs, we will provide the attestation and a short remediation summary.

We apologize for the inconvenience. Protecting the integrity of your audit trail is a top priority and we are treating this as a high-priority remediation.

D Keisha, Customer Success
```

Tom Baker: Good. For the two renewal accounts include the optional sentence: "We can extend log retention for your tenant at no additional charge for the remainder of your current term, subject to approval; your CS lead will discuss details in the follow-up." Jules, does that wording work?

Jules Martin (Legal): Slight tweak: change to "we can discuss a temporary extension of retention at no additional charge, subject to exec approval and documentation." That keeps approvals and paperwork explicit.

Arjun Patel: I'll prepare an AE one-pager with impacted tenants, size estimates, suggested talking points for compliance reviewers, and a checklist for the assisted verification session (sample queries to validate, time windows to inspect).

Sofia Lopez: I'll own scheduling the verification sessions and the attestation template. Also recommend a short feedback capture form for affected customers so we can track residual concerns and any reportable downstream impacts.

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting scheduled tomorrow 9:30 AM PT. Recovery progress channel: #inc-1142-recovery.

Keisha Morgan: Thanks team 1D I'll send the short note to the affected tenants after we finalize the retention wording with Jules and include the attestation follow-up plan. :white_check_mark:
